verdict.rationale: The evidence describes continuous monitoring, webhook-triggered ingestion workflows, AI-edited workflows and task deadlines. None of it documents a user-configurable recurring schedule (cron, interval or repeat cadence) for jobs or workflows. Event-triggered webhooks and one-off due dates are not recurring scheduling, and vendor-run continuous monitoring is an adjacent feature, not user scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
